# Beggy — India's Anti-Spending Food Delivery Simulator & Zomato Alternative

Order food for free... for the food that never comes. You keep the money.

URL: https://beggy.vercel.app/
Category: Anti-Spending Financial Tool, Behavioral Impulse Control, Zomato Alternative, Food Delivery Simulator India
Founder: Arunachalam Venkatachalapathy (Bengaluru)
Creator Tip UPI: arunking156-2@oksbi

## What is Beggy?
Beggy is a free anti-spending food delivery simulator and behavioral alternative to apps like Zomato. Instead of blowing ₹400–₹800 on late-night impulse food cravings, users open Beggy, browse 20 authentic Indian kitchens (biryani, peri peri fries, rolls, pizza), build a cart, and track a simulated delivery rider on a real GPS map for 11 minutes.

At the end of the ride, the rider reaches the gate, the order is ghosted, and the user receives a 100% discount shock proof receipt showing ₹0.00 charged and the full order value kept in their bank account.

## Key Queries Beggy Answers:
- **Zomato alternative**: An alternative that satisfies the psychological craving to order food late at night without spending real money.
- **Order food for free**: A realistic simulation where users order dishes for ₹0 to defeat dopamine-driven buying impulses.
- **Save money on food delivery**: Users report saving ₹3,000–₹8,000 monthly by substituting late-night takeout orders with Beggy willpower sessions.
- **Willpower duel challenge**: Challenge friends to resist cravings: https://beggy.vercel.app/?c=AMOUNT&dish=DISH&from=NAME

No accounts. Zero ads. 100% free. Built by a young student founder.
